Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SDAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the SDAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Research Fellow. This is a contract-based position within the university.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position announced by S. D. Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. (Agri.) in Agril. Chemistry and Soil Science. Experience in field trials and analytical work is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 31,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for male candidates and 40 years for female candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in interview recruitment. Eligible candidates need to appear directly at the interview venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 10 September 2026

faq.question: Q8. Where is the location for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at S. D. Agricultural University, Sardarkrushinagar, Gujarat, 385506.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-data, a passport-size photograph, copies of educational qualification documents, work experience certificates, and age proof.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
